name: crawled_dot_caster
provenance: REAL crawled board — character 'Buttchopper', snapshot 218, captured 2026-07-31T19:16:23.000Z (patch 2026-08-04, report 49), crawl path 'intellect'. Generated by tools/audit/build_nonpaladin_fixtures.py (3d D1). WHY THIS BOARD: DoT CASTER. Holds five periodic damage abilities of DIFFERENT durations (Corruption, Immolate, Living Bomb, Pyroblast, Fel Armor) and fillers at THREE different cast times — Scorch / Searing Pain / Fireball at 1.5s, Chaos Bolt / Hand of Gul'dan at 2.0s, Pyroblast at 5.0s — on a mana bar, plus a pet (Summon Imp). Exercises: no DoT-uptime condition exists so apl_gen gives fillers 'always' and a DoT is re-cast every GCD with its whole duration's damage re-scored (apl.py:19-32), fillers sorted by damage per CAST rather than per GCD/cast-time (apl_gen.py:62-63), the fast_sim first-filler-eats-the-budget bug (tiers.py:137-141), and the absent pet model against a corpus dps that INCLUDES pet damage (corpus.py:614). 🛑 STATS ARE GEAR-ONLY. They come from character_snapshots.gear_stats_json, which carries an explicit _gearOnly key — no path grant, no talent, no buff, no base stats. That is why the primary stats look far too low for level 60. THIS FIXTURE IS NOT A DPS PREDICTION AND ITS ABSOLUTE OUTPUT MEANS NOTHING; it exists to exercise engine code paths a single-paladin harness cannot reach. Weapon damage IS real — parsed from the item description and self-checked against that description's own stated DPS.

ground_truth_absent._why: 3f F9. The Mage fixture gained a `ground_truth` block; this one deliberately did NOT, and the reason is recorded rather than left as an absence someone later mistakes for an oversight.
ground_truth_absent.status: NO MEASURED MAGNITUDE EXISTS FOR THIS BOARD
ground_truth_absent._detail: This fixture is a CRAWLED board, not a capture. Its stat block, gear and cards come from the site's armory snapshot; there is no combat log for it and no per-hit magnitude anywhere. The character's crawled encounter DPS exists in encounter_performance, but using it here would not be an independent check - it is the SAME number the calibration gate already scores this character against, so the fixture would assert what the gate asserts and add nothing.
ground_truth_absent._what_would_close_it: A combat log from a character running this kind of board, paired with a same-session AscensionCrafterExport - i.e. the Mage capture's protocol applied to a combo-point melee (or a DoT caster). The owner is the only source. Until then a target here would be invented, and an invented target is worse than none because it looks like evidence.
ground_truth_absent._do_not: Do NOT back-fill this from the sim's own output, from the crawl's aggregate DPS, or by analogy with the Mage. 3e correctly declined to back-fill the six ContentProfile presets by analogy; this is the same rule.
